maintenance_items.label: Brake pads
maintenance_items.description: Friction compound wears with use. Below 3mm thickness, braking distance increases dangerously.

maintenance_items.label: Tires
maintenance_items.description: Tires degrade both by mileage and age. Incorrect pressure or uneven wear compromises grip and safety.

maintenance_items.label: Brake fluid
maintenance_items.description: Brake fluid is hygroscopic: it absorbs moisture, reducing its boiling point and braking effectiveness.

maintenance_items.label: Cabin filter
maintenance_items.description: The cabin filter purifies the air entering the interior. A saturated filter reduces HVAC efficiency and can generate odors.

maintenance_items.label: Coolant
maintenance_items.description: Coolant loses its antifreeze and anticorrosive properties over time, potentially damaging the engine's internal circuit.
